lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the branchial region. The centroids are organized into approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, with inter-blob distance increasing slightly in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of spots. The primary high-intensity blobs are located at these intersection nodes, creating a distinctive anchor-point pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is observed running along the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance (upper) to low-luminance (lower) shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, yellow-and-black striped teleost fish positioned immediately superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
